title: Foundry Orientation: Bring the Dashboard Online
briefing: Open the internal-preview dashboard, confirm the What Now panel, then verify the first Lens Deep Scan handoff. This is the Pack #2 launcher-preview entry point, not a public release start.
fieldGuide: Use Lens Deep Scan once. The scan result should unlock the Pack #2 welcome and grid commissioning Index pages, then Terminal should advance the next objective toward First Tool Check.

objectives.label: Deep Scan any block
objectives.detail: Use Lens Deep Scan once to verify the first guidance loop.

objectives.label: Read the next objective
objectives.detail: Open the Foundry dashboard and confirm the next objective panel points to First Tool Check.

rewards.label: Hand Crank Generator
rewards.detail: Starter manual power source for the first loop; shown first so testers know what to place next.

rewards.label: Small Battery Bank
rewards.detail: Starter storage for the first loop and the first required Lens scan target.

rewards.label: Low Voltage Cable Bundle
rewards.detail: Enough cable to connect the generator and battery without opening larger grids.

rewards.label: Grid Diagnostic Tool
rewards.detail: A safe first-system tool for checking starter grid state.

metadata.completionFeedback: Foundry dashboard online. First Tool Check is now active, and the internal preview route is ready for launcher review.

previewCardCopy: Begin the launcher preview review from this Foundry dashboard route.

failureStates.label: Lens is not installed or disabled
failureStates.message: Read the Terminal What Now panel and Index overview; the scan objective remains unavailable until Lens is present.

failureStates.label: Terminal dashboard did not open
failureStates.message: Use the Index Foundry overview as fallback guidance and rerun Pack #2 profile validation.

commonIssueText: If the objective does not advance, confirm Lens scan completion, then check the Terminal next-objective panel and Pack #2 known issues.
